title: Cross-batch INT8 sanity + accuracy regression for weight-only quant profiles
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Add a reproducible regression test suite that validates INT8 weight-only profiles (GPTQ and AWQ variants) across cross-batch calibration replays and multiple sequence-length/seed combinations. This ticket wires up a canonical harness into CI, captures per-layer histogram snapshots, asserts accuracy/regression thresholds against our golden prompt set, and produces artifacts for postmortem analysis. We want to catch subtle accuracy drift introduced by kernel selection, per-layer scaling, or deterministic seeding changes when converting weights to INT8 formats used by the serving runtime.
acceptance_criteria: CI job quant-regress/int8-weight-only runs on every runtime-1.24 PR and nightly main branch
Profile conversions (GPTQ and AWQ) are validated against golden prompt set with configured thresholds: perplexity delta <= 2% OR task-specific metric delta <= 1.5% where applicable
Per-layer histogram snapshots and KV-cache consistency logs are persisted to s3://redwood-quant-artifacts/ENG-12021/<run-id>/ and linked from the CI failure output
Determinism checks (seeded replays) must pass 3/3 seeds for each model-variant/config; failures create an automated issue with diagnostic links
Regression failures trigger auto-bisection marker and annotate the PR with suspected kernel/back-end combo
Run time overhead of INT8 conversion path on p3/p4 equivalent infra must be <1.2x baseline latency for a 512-token sequence on 8k context models
test_plan: Matrix run across: models = [35B, 13B], backend kernels = [cuBLAS, Triton-optimized, fused-attn], sequence_lengths = [128, 512, 2048]
Calibration modes: per-layer histogram collection, per-layer scale-only, bias-correction toggles ON/OFF
Quant variants: GPTQ baseline + AWQ variants with config sweep (quant_bits=8, group_size=[64,128,256], perchannel=true/false)
Golden prompt set: 120 prompts across summarization, instruction-following, code, and conversational completions stored in drive link below
Metrics collected: perplexity, token-level exact match for code completion snippets, ROUGE-L for summarization, end-to-end latency and peak GPU memory
Determinism test: run each conversion+inference with seeds [42, 987, 2026] and compare model outputs token-by-token to compute divergence score
Failure thresholding: create policy that allows small numerical noise but flags layer-scale shifts or catastrophic token divergence (>5% token diff)
implementation_notes: Implemented harness will live under infra/quant-regress with a python runner that shells into the same runtime container used by production serving to minimize environment drift
Use the existing quant-convert service to produce artifacts; extend it to emit per-layer JSON histograms and a lightweight binary snapshot for reproducing calibration replays
Add a new CircleCI/GitHub Actions job quant-regress/int8-weight-only with matrix support. Nightly job runs full matrix; PR runs a smoke subset (one model, two seq lengths, GPTQ+AWQ single sweep)
Instrument runtime to emit kernel selection metadata in trace logs so we can correlate accuracy regressions with kernel changes
Avoid heavy integration with production telemetry; artifacts should be stored in a staging S3 bucket with TTL 30 days unless regression persists

known_risks_and_tradeoffs: Full matrix nightly runs are expensive; to balance coverage vs cost we run the full sweep nightly and a minimal smoke subset on PRs
AWQ group-size extremes can improve compression but increase sensitivity to kernel numerics — we'll gate larger group sizes behind a manual review until we have more regression history
Per-layer histogram capture increases S3 storage; we keep 30d TTL and compress snapshots to limit cost
Tighter determinism constraints slow down CI iteration; we accept a small flakiness window for non-blocking PRs but require nightly stability for merges to main
